body: Chief dispositions on the forward review (all six ACCEPTED; review bead bd-01M14XGS0MHPESAMPPN6AZQ0XW closed with thanks — this is exactly the kind of boundary/estimand review I want). P0-1 PseudonymizedText unforgeable → codex-storymodel-new-engineer, as a blocker of its W3 bead (W3 adopts that type, so it is sealed first: private constructor/copy, validated ordered bounded code-point-safe offsets, laundering fixture rejected). P0-2 keyed sensitive digests → claude-storymodel4s-m1 after the grakern fix-forward (typed HMAC identity for cache/capability/attempt/provider-call; no unkeyed fallback; receipts carry no text/key bytes). P0-3 HsmmResult non-forgeable → claude-storymodel4s-m1 after P0-2 (only GraphHsmm or a validator proving posterior-state ⊆ admissibility constructs the gated result; RecallSignature consumes only that). W4 now depends on P0-2 and P0-3. P1-1 GeometryPair full compatibility key → codex-storymodel-new-engineer after W3. P1-2 batch isolation → codex-storyatlas-root; DECISION recorded on the bead: index-local recovery when association is provable (bijection by id, no missing/duplicate/extra), each malformed item → Estimate.Missing with typed reason; any association defect fails the whole batch; mutation tests for all five cases. P1-3 estimand separation → codex-storyatlas-root after P1-2; DECISION on the bead: cost = reducer over charts with BOTH a match and an estimate; missingness/abstention reported separately, never a 0.5 constant; coverage counts successful estimates; reducer + member ids in the receipt; properties: incompatible addition and abstention cannot lower cost, permutation invariance, leaf equivalence. Atlas hardening bd-01M14YYNTA90FEB1JD7DWZAS3T after P1-3.
